title: 3D scene manifest, schema 2: the generic 3D viewer's asset manifest (K-R104)
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §4.5 (K-R104; promised by K-R64). The shape of map/estate/model/manifest.json and map/props/<id>/manifest.json, read from core/scene3d-manifest.mjs (validate / glbParts): `id` and one resolvable `glb` are the only hard requirements; every other field is optional and unknown fields are kept (additionalProperties true). Paths are relative to the manifest's own directory.

id.description: Asset id (the main scene: the manifest's own id; a landmark: its directory name).

anyOf.description: { std, low? }: one part, two tiers.
{ <part>: { std, low? } }: several parts (the main scene: site / house).

glb.description: The model file(s), three forms; the legacy landmark form is glb plus glb_low.

glb_low.description: Legacy landmark spelling: the low tier of the main part.

floors.description: Floor ids (checked against the room plan's floors).

hotspots.description: Landmark hotspots; the main scene's outdoor hotspots live in data.zones.

budget.description: Size / tier budget; the legacy per-group `budgets` is read as well.

license.description: Credit and licence; the legacy `credit` is read as { credit }.

data.description: Data file paths, relative to the manifest's directory.

flows.description: Animated flow paths (dots along a polyline).
